podcast.title: New Zealand Revival Band
podcast.body: The Datsons are noted as one of the Garage Rock revival bands that emerged from New Zealand in the early 2000s. "There were the Datsons out of New Zealand."

podcast.body: The Datsuns are considered part of the "raw indie rock scene," often grouped with bands like The Vines, The Hives, The Strokes, and The Doves. "part of that whole raw indie rock scene."
